frozenBeforeRequests.order: For case index i, rotate profiles left by i modulo model count; requests are sequential.

catalog.pricingCaveat: Catalog prices are indicative, not measured charges. Latency routing can select a more expensive endpoint.

limits: Twelve reused development/acceptance cases, not held-out accuracy or a latency distribution. Same Rust prompt/schema, 256-token completion budget and one correction attempt; reasoning may consume the budget. HTTP connections to Rust are new per request; each model has its own reusable provider pool. Startup only warms transport. Provider route, queue, cache and model cold/warm state are uncontrolled. Medians include errors for all-supported results and are separately shown for correct supported plans. Unsupported refusals are excluded from both latency medians. No browser, database, photons or p95 measured.
